headlines.title: Senators to vote on holding Fauci in contempt for pleading the Fifth during hearing
headlines.description: Fauci declined to answer senators’ questions over 100 times during last week’s hearing, angering Republican lawmakers who have targeted him for years.

headlines.title: Three state attorneys general subpoena Anthony Fauci over Covid guidance
headlines.description: Fauci was subpoenaed as Republicans in Washington seek to hold him in contempt for refusing to answer questions about the handling of the Covid pandemic.

headlines.title: Progressive Democrat scores narrow victory in Michigan primary
headlines.description: Abdul El-Sayed's projected victory over Rep. Haley Stevens delivers another win for progressives in the battle over the Democratic Party's direction, setting up a closely watched general election in Michigan. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster reports.

headlines.title: New Mexico AG sues Blanche and DOJ, accuses them of impeding state's Epstein probe
headlines.description: New Mexico attorney general Raúl Torrez is suing Todd Blanche and the Justice Department for blocking the state from gaining access to the unredacted Epstein files. Torres joins Hallie Jackson to explain the significance of gaining access to the files.

headlines.title: Trump reacts to Abdul El-Sayed's win in Michigan Democratic Senate primary
headlines.description: After Abdul El-Sayed's win in the Michigan Democratic Senate primary, President Donald Trump called El-Sayed a "communist threat."

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Progressives had another big primary night — with a notable exception: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: New CDC director is confirmed, giving agency its first permanent leader in a year
headlines.description: Dr. Erica Schwartz, who was deputy surgeon general in Trump’s first term, inherits a measles crisis and a growing cyclosporiasis outbreak.

headlines.title: Rep. Chuck Edwards drops re-election bid after censure recommendation over harassment claims
headlines.description: Rep. Chuck Edwards is withdrawing from his re-election campaign in Western North Carolina.

headlines.title: Candidate who dropped out beats Trump’s pick in a battleground GOP House primary
headlines.description: Thomas Smith, a political unknown who raised almost no money for his campaign, defeated President Donald Trump’s endorsed candidate in a Republican primary for a Michigan congressional seat the GOP hopes to contest this fall, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Democratic Senate primary in Michigan, a big victory for the left in a key race
headlines.description: The former public health official has defeated Rep. Haley Stevens, NBC News projects, despite facing a huge advertising disadvantage.

headlines.title: Democratic Rep. Shri Thanedar loses his primary to a progressive challenger in Michigan
headlines.description: Thanedar was unseated by Donavan McKinney, a state representative endorsed by Bernie Sanders and Abdul El-Sayed, NBC News projects.
